text: The Patriots salvaged what was shaping up as a potentially season-defining collapse with a stunning 29-26 comeback victory over the Bills at Highmark Stadium on Sunday, becoming the first team to win in Buffalo's new building and handing Josh Allen his first defeat of the season—a result that head coach Mike Vrabel characterized as critical for the defending AFC East champions. Drake Maye, who had been mired in an early-season slide, rebounded emphatically with three touchdown passes despite two turnovers, orchestrating a game-winning drive that proved he didn't need to be flawless to get the job done, and film analysts have already begun breaking down how the Patriots' offense finally broke through after a rough start. The victory pulled New England back from the brink of a 1-3 record and into the 2-2 conversation alongside the Rams and Cowboys, though observers are cautiously examining whether this week's comebacks signal genuine season-saving momentum or merely a cautionary tale about overreacting to a single impressive Sunday.
